C++ — Wire sweep

This feature is available only on camera models and firmware that provide line-scan APIs and are configured for a line-scan capture mode.

This module starts a line scan, waits for the completion event, reads status, and stops an active scan when required.

API Reference

startLineScan(ip, frameId, …​)

Purpose: Start the current pattern line sweep and return to the frame of this session ID.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

std::string

Camera address.

frameId

std::string &

Frame identifier.

enableTexture

bool

Whether to generate texture data; Default: true.

deferEpicRawSave

bool

Whether to defer EpicRaw generation; Default: true.

Returns: bool.

startLineScan(ip, …​)

Purpose: Start a sweep and don’t return. frameId, which applies to scenes that do not require downloading of the results.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

std::string

Camera address.

enableTexture

bool

Whether to generate texture data; Default: true.

deferEpicRawSave

bool

Whether to defer EpicRaw generation; Default: true.

Returns: bool.

waitLineScanCompletion(ip, timeoutMs)

Purpose: Wait for the line scan to complete and return the captured frame ID.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

std::string

Camera address.

timeoutMs

int

Maximum wait time in milliseconds; Default: 60000.

Returns: bool;received EOT Yes. true`anomalous state, early closing of connection or timeout `false.

Purpose: Reads the current or latest line-cleaning session.

Parameters

ip

std::string

Camera address.

LineScanStatus &

Line-scan or stream status.

lineScanStatusToString(status)

Purpose: Converts the status count to a name that corresponds to the camera response.

Parameters

Name Type Description

status

LineScanStatus

Line-scan or stream status.

Returns: const char*.

stopLineScan(ip, statusHex)

Purpose: Actively stop the sweep and use it for cancellation or extraordinary cleaning.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

std::string

Camera address.

statusHex

std::string &

Value of statusHex.

Returns: bool. == Example: Full sweep

std::string frameId;
if (!TFTech::EpicEye::startLineScan(ip, frameId, true, false)) return;

if (!TFTech::EpicEye::waitLineScanCompletion(ip, 120000)) {
    std::string status;
    TFTech::EpicEye::stopLineScan(ip, status);
    return;
}

std::vector<uint8_t> raw;
if (!TFTech::EpicEye::getFrameInEpicRaw(ip, frameId, raw)) return;

Of course I do. EOT No further calls are required. stopLineScan. Use this if you want to use it immediately after completion frameId Download EpicRaw, it’s to be passed on at startup deferEpicRawSave=false.
